svg.aria-label: The curvature bound for Gerver's cap on the interval from 0 to π/2: the density r(t) of its surface area measure (blue) lies below k₀(g(t)) (orange, dashed); they agree on two intervals, from t₁ to about 0.62 and from t₃ to t₄, and the gap between them is shaded
